entry.name: live.meter~
entry.category: Live UI Objects, Live MSP Objects
entry.description: live.meter~ is a simple mono Live-style signal level meter that can be attached to any signal whose level is between -1 and 1 (other signals should be scaled first).

attributes.digest: Active mode enable
attributes.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) the meter display.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.digest: Sets the maximum update-time interval, in milliseconds, of thedisplay.
attributes.description: Sets the maximum update-time interval, in milliseconds, of thedisplay. The minimum update-interval is 10 milliseconds, the maximum is 2 seconds, and the default is 50 milliseconds. This message also sets the rate at whichsends out the peak value received in that time interval. Theorattributes are used to limit the refresh and the output, depending on the setting of theattribute.

attributes.name: threshold_db
attributes.digest: Redraw Threshold (dB)
attributes.description: When theobject'sattribute is set to 0, this attribute sets the refresh threshold in deciBels. If the signal peak delta is greater than the threshold value, the object will be redrawn and the value sent out the outlet.

attributes.name: threshold_linear
attributes.digest: Redraw Threshold (Linear)
attributes.description: When theobject'sattribute is set to 1, this attribute sets the refresh threshold in deciBels. If the signal peak delta is greater than the threshold value, the object will be redrawn and the value sent out the outlet.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: warmcolor
attributes.digest: Warm signal color
attributes.description: Sets the Warm signal color in RGBA format.

messages.name: db
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point number that specficies a deciBel value, will set theobject to react as though a signal with that dB peak-value has been passed to its input. Corresponding LEDs will light up and the value will be passed out the outlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: When no signal is connected to theobject's inlet, a float number will set the meter to react as though a signal with equal amplitude peak-value has been passed to its input. Corresponding LEDs will light up and the peak-level value will be passed out the outlet (0.0 will show silence, 0.0 through 1.0 will light up to any but the overload LED, and anything above 1.0 will light all LEDs including overload).

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Display peak amplitude of the signal
messages.description: The peak amplitude of the incoming signal is displayed by the on-screen level meter.

outlets.description: Peak Value For Each Metering Interval
